role: helper V, fidelity reviewer, part 2 (fence fixes)

verdicts.FX-OUT: relied on with a stated limit: safety only (ReadyNotDiscarded, NoStaleAccepted). Liveness and Slots rest on an oracle commit-close of a mid-write child that the fix itself makes necessary; no joint run with FX-CLOSE
verdicts.FX-CLAIM: relied on with a stated limit: safety only, under a stronger assumption. MF:1144 forbids a stall before the first tool call exactly when FX_CLAIM is on, and the ablation trace uses that stall. Reading (i) must mean every live session claims or dies within the lease. Liveness is not relied on: step 7 is modelled on true liveness and hides an INFERRED slot leak (dead folder sessions in a tombstoned attempt are never closed)
verdicts.FX-CGATE-Q5a: relied on with a stated limit: narrow configuration; the nonce bind and the hook-to-effect window are merged
verdicts.FX-CGATE-Q5b: cannot be relied on: BOUNDED, with liveness analysed in only 30 of 43 parts
verdicts.FX-CLOSE: relied on with a stated limit: the process list is always available and PROBE 10 is assumed; the close, its effect and its record are one step
verdicts.FX-PLAN: relied on with a stated limit: its ablation shows a defect that FX-CGATE creates, not an as-built one; the watcher delegates only partly

part1_gaps: Both closed as meant. The D7-SLOTS-HELD and D3 reruns are honest.
